title: NEON SPRAWL  -  Part 1: Bad Debts
subtitle: Part 1 of 2  -  the Redline runner's tale
tagline: A nobody runner in the Redline slums takes one bad job and ends up holding a secret the whole city will kill for. Start here.

title: NEON SPRAWL  -  Part 2: Ghost Protocol
subtitle: Part 2 of 2  -  the war for the wire
tagline: Six months after the Idol job, a corp called Helix is building a killswitch for every body in the city, and a choir of awakened AIs wants it for themselves. You're a legend now. Time to earn it. (A separate, harder campaign - start a fresh runner here.)

title: NEON SPRAWL  -  Part 3: Ascension
subtitle: Part 3 of 3  -  the long climb
tagline: A year after the Uplink, a merged AI-corp called Meridian is building ASCENSION: a machine to upload the human race into a single mind, in a station at the top of the orbital tether. This is the long climb, from the ruined streets to the edge of space. The biggest, hardest run of your life. (A separate campaign - bring a fresh legend.)
